An '''Emitter Setting Adjust''' was a weapon component. The [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] had an Emitter Setting Adjust that wrapped around the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], close to the [[emitter nozzle]].<ref name="EGWT" />
